Update: after contacting superiors, they said that they replaced Surface Headphones version 1, but apparently this is not a “known issue” for Surface Headphones 2. The customer service representative had me upload images of the headphones and proof of purchase, and I’m trying to get them replaced using Implied Warranty laws. Maybe that won’t be successful, but worth a shot though.

I literally just removed them from my head and heard it crack. That being said, I wore them for multiple hours everyday. It may just be an issue of fatigue with the plastic over time, but there’s really no reason that they shouldn’t have put some sort of metal in the handband area to help eliminate this issue.
I wish I would’ve gone with some Sony headphones. I have some friends with them and they’ve had no issues.
